index.title: Outreach
index.description: Agents people can reach from a chat app, through a bot that answers as each one.
index.emptyBody: An agent appears here once it has a bot. Add an agent to give it a Feishu bot.

add.title: Add an agent
add.description: Pick the agent people should reach. Next, you give it a Feishu bot.
add.footnote_one: {{count}} agent has no bot. Agents are created and edited in Apps.
add.footnote_other: {{count}} agents have no bot. Agents are created and edited in Apps.

newBot.title: Give {{agent}} a Feishu bot
newBot.description: The bot answers as {{agent}}. You can point it at another agent later.
newBot.name: Bot name in Feishu
newBot.nameHint: People see this name in groups and @mention it.
newBot.qrAlt: QR code for the Feishu app
newBot.scanBody: Feishu creates the {{bot}} bot in your workspace and hands it to Rome.

overview.botsBody: These bots answer as {{agent}}. Each one also shows in Connections.
overview.noBots: {{agent}} has no bot yet. Give it a Feishu bot, then invite the bot to any group or DM.
overview.inviteBody: Open a group, then Settings, Group bots, Add bot, and pick {{bot}}. To start a DM, search for {{bot}} in Feishu. Chats appear here on their own.

chat.shared_one: {{bots}} is in this chat too. Rome keeps one history for it, so every agent here reads the same messages.
chat.shared_other: {{bots}} are in this chat too. Rome keeps one history for it, so every agent here reads the same messages.
chat.settings: Chat settings: answers when @mentioned · replies in thread

activity.description: What was said to and by {{agent}} across its chats, newest first.

settings.readOthersBody: When off, {{agent}} only sees the chat it is answering in.
settings.introduce: Introduce itself when added to a group
settings.introduceBody: Posts one short hello with what it can help with.
settings.botsBody: Answers as sets the agent a bot speaks for. Groups cannot override it.
settings.moveConfirm_one: Move {{bot}} to {{to}}? From now on {{to}} answers in its {{count}} chat. The chat and its history stay as they are.
settings.moveConfirm_other: Move {{bot}} to {{to}}? From now on {{to}} answers in its {{count}} chats. The chats and their history stay as they are.
settings.foldersBody: Limits which files the agent can read or write. Shell access is off for agents with folders.
settings.noFolders: No folders. This agent sees the whole workspace.
